# Number of Students Doing Homework at a Given Time.

@example Students 0 and 1 are working during minute 5; student 1 only during that minute.
[2,5,1,8]
[6,5,4,9]
5
=> 2

@example Minute 17 comes after student 0 stops and before student 1 begins.
[10,20]
[15,30]
17
=> 0

@example Minute 7 is the first minute of student 0 and the last of students 1 and 2; both ends count.
[7,1,4]
[9,7,7]
7
=> 3

# One student, working during queryTime only.
[1]
[1]
1
=> 1

# One student, working only during the minute before queryTime.
[5]
[5]
6
=> 0

# queryTime is where every interval starts.
[4,4,4]
[8,9,10]
4
=> 3

# queryTime is where every interval ends.
[3,1,5]
[6,6,6]
6
=> 3

# One-minute intervals: only the one at queryTime counts.
[3,4,5]
[3,4,5]
4
=> 1

# queryTime before every interval, then after every interval.
[10,20,30]
[15,25,35]
5
=> 0

[10,20,30]
[15,25,35]
40
=> 0

# queryTime at the bounds: [1, 1000] always counts.
[1,1000,1]
[1000,1000,1]
1000
=> 2

[1,1,500]
[1000,1,1000]
1
=> 2

# Overlapping and nested intervals, in no order.
[50,10,30,40,60]
[60,90,35,45,70]
42
=> 2

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[3,5,2,3,4,7,3]
[3,8,3,3,8,8,4]
3
=> 4

@gen 2 small
[1,2,1,1,2]
[1,3,3,2,3]
3
=> 3

@gen 3 small
[2,1,2,1,1,1,1,1]
[3,2,3,2,1,3,2,3]
3
=> 4

@gen 4 small
[2,3,1,2]
[5,3,1,5]
1
=> 1

@gen 5 small
[3,3,3,2,1,1]
[4,4,3,3,3,3]
3
=> 6

@gen 6 small
[9,2]
[12,5]
2
=> 1
